mechanism_claims.claim_text: TA plus TB-YK is supported as causing bacterial membrane perturbation/disruption in S. aureus A170 and S. enterica serovar Paratyphi B under the reported microscopy conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is limited to membrane perturbation/morphology context; no molecular target binding constant is reported.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The TA/TB-YK combination has source-supported synergistic or enhanced antibacterial phenotype in Table 2/Figure 4, with FIC values <=0.5 for S. aureus A170, S. aureus A172, and S. enterica serovar Paratyphi and >0.5/no-interaction values for other listed targets.
mechanism_claims.limitations: FIC/inhibition-zone data demonstrate synergy phenotype but are not promoted to a direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The selected 75/35 TA/TB-YK pool has source-supported in vivo antibacterial protection and anti-inflammatory host-response context in infected mice.
